attrs.summary: **Important** Nova Reel reached end of life on September 30, 2026 and is no longer available. Requests to this model fail with ResourceNotFoundException: This model version has reached the end of its life. For models that are currently available, see Models at a glance. For how model lifecycle stages work, see Model lifecycle. Nova Reel is Amazon's video generation model that creates short videos from text and image prompts with camera motion controls. For more information about model development and performance, see the model/service card.
